events.title: Devlog #9: Water & Thermos
events.summary: New: Drinking WaterYou can now drink directly from lakes and rivers.New: ThermosCraft a Thermos to carry water with you.Fill it at any lake or river.Each Thermos holds 3 uses and needs to be refilled after that.Balance ChangesThirst no longer drains as quickly.The Weapon Workbench no longer requires a blueprint to build.Coming Soon: Durability We’ve laid the groundwork for a durability system. Soon, your items will wear down as you use them, so take care of your gear!

Walkers is an open-world zombie survival game about building an outpost, crafting, and keeping your recruited survivors alive in a post-apocalyptic wasteland. Every survivor matters: low morale can make them rebel or run away, and the ones you lose don’t come back.When can I play?
